S1211.reason: Under FRCP 4, service on individuals and corporations may follow state rules; leaving with secretaries or email is not authorized by the rule, and the plaintiff cannot serve personally.

S1212.reason: Custom is incorporated if it is reasonable, certain, and consistent with statute, so it is not incorporated where it conflicts with legislation.

S1214.reason: VCLT Article 7 presumes heads of state, heads of government, foreign ministers, and heads of diplomatic missions have authority to conclude treaties.
